description: This Java source file implements the AdHocReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve and map ad-hoc query data from a database, including retrieving all queries, active queries, and a specific query by ID. It also contains an inner class for mapping database rows to AdHocData objects.

classes.name: AdHocReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AdHocReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to query ad-hoc data from the database.

classes.name: AdHocMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL ResultSet rows to AdHocData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllAdHocQuery
methods.description: Retrieves all ad-hoc query records from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAllActiveAdHocQuery
methods.description: Retrieves all active ad-hoc query records.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single AdHocData record by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveNewAdHocDetails
methods.description: Returns a new, empty AdHocData object template.
